tickets.subject: Invoices show the wrong VAT rate for EU customers
tickets.body:
Since the March release, invoices for EU customers are showing 0% VAT instead of the country rate. Finance has paused sending anything out. This affects roughly two hundred invoices already generated.

Workaround for now is to regenerate the invoice after setting the billing country by hand, which does apply the right rate.

tickets.subject: SSO login loops back to the sign-in page
tickets.body:
Users are sent back to the sign-in page after authenticating with Okta. It started after they rotated their signing certificate.

The redirect URL in their Okta app still points at the old callback path, which we deprecated in February.

tickets.subject: Bulk import silently drops rows with empty postcodes
tickets.body:
A customer imported four thousand records and got no error, but only three thousand nine hundred arrived. The missing rows all have an empty postcode field.

The importer treats an empty postcode as an invalid address and skips the row without reporting it.

tickets.subject: Refund request — duplicate annual charge
tickets.body:
Customer was charged twice for the annual plan on the same day. Card ending 4417.

Both charges cleared. The second one came from a retry after a gateway timeout that had in fact succeeded.

tickets.subject: Escalation: repeated outage reports from Acme
tickets.body:
Third outage report this month. The customer is asking for a written explanation and is hinting at the renewal.

All three coincide with the nightly reindex window.

articles.title: VAT rates by country
articles.body:
Invoices apply the VAT rate of the customer's billing country. If the billing country is missing, no rate is applied and the invoice shows 0%.

Set the billing country on the customer record and regenerate the invoice; the rate is applied at generation time, not at send time.

articles.title: SSO callback paths after the February change
articles.body:
The callback path moved from /auth/callback to /sso/callback in February. Identity providers configured before that date keep working until the signing certificate is rotated, at which point the old path stops being accepted.

Update the redirect URL in the identity provider, not in our settings.

articles.title: Importer validation rules
articles.body:
The importer requires a non-empty postcode for any row with a country that uses postal codes. Rows failing validation are skipped.

Skipped rows are counted in the import summary but are not listed individually, which is a known gap.

articles.title: Refund authority and limits
articles.body:
Agents may refund up to 500 without approval. Above that, a supervisor signs off. Duplicate charges caused by gateway retries are always refunded in full and do not count against the limit.

Never tell a customer a refund is approved before it has been.

articles.title: Renewal risk playbook
articles.body:
An account with three or more outage reports in a quarter is flagged to the renewal team. Do not discuss renewal terms with the customer directly; hand it to the account manager.

Written outage explanations go through the supervisor before they are sent.
